+# Function definitions
+def dot(v1, v2):
+    """Dot product of two 3D vectors."""
+    return v1[0]*v2[0] + v1[1]*v2[1] + v1[2]*v2[2]
+
+def distance_squared(v1, v2):
+    """Squared distance between two 3D vectors."""
+    return dot(v1, v2)
+
+def gradient(v1, v2):
+    """Negative gradient of repulsion energy w.r.t. vector v1."""
+    d_sq = distance_squared(v1, v2)
+    if d_sq == 0:
+        return (0, 0, 0)
+    d = math.sqrt(d_sq)
+    exp_term = math.pow(d, -DISTANCE_EXPONENT)
+    return (-exp_term * v1[0], -exp_term * v1[1], -exp_term * v1[2])
+
+def repulsion_energy(points, distance_squared_func=distance_squared):
+    """Sum of repulsion energies between all pairs of points."""
+    energy = 0.0
+    for i in range(len(points)):
+        for j in range(i + 1, len(points)):
+            d_sq = distance_squared_func(points[i], points[j])
+            if d_sq == 0:
+                continue  # Skip pairs with zero distance (shouldn't happen for valid points)
+            d = math.sqrt(d_sq)
+            exp_term = math.pow(d, -DISTANCE_EXPONENT)
+            energy += exp_term
+    return energy
